title: Hebrews Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Hebrews 8: the high priest seated in the heavens, the copy and shadow of heavenly things, and the new covenant promised by the Lord.

questions.text: Where did the high priest spoken of in verse 1 sit down?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens.

answers.text: In the Holy of Holies in Jerusalem
On the right hand of the throne of the Majesty
Among the priests of the order of Levi
Beside the altar of burnt offering

questions.text: Who pitched the true tabernacle, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 calls him a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, not man.

answers.text: Moses
Aaron
The people of Israel
The Lord

questions.text: What do the priests on earth serve, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says they serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things.

answers.text: A copy and shadow of the heavenly things
The throne of the Majesty itself
A tent that was made without hands
The city of the living God

questions.text: Where was the pattern for the tabernacle shown to Moses?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says Moses was warned to make everything according to the pattern that was shown to him on the mountain.

answers.text: In Egypt
At the Red Sea
On the mountain
In the Holy Place

questions.text: Of what is he called the mediator in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says he has obtained a more excellent ministry, inasmuch as he is also the mediator of a better covenant.

answers.text: The first covenant
A better covenant
The law of Moses
The earthly sanctuary

questions.text: With which two houses does the Lord say he will make a new covenant?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 quotes the Lord saying he will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.

answers.text: The house of Israel and the house of Judah
The house of Levi and the house of Aaron
The house of David alone
The houses of Egypt and of Israel

questions.text: What does the Lord say about the covenant he made with their fathers?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says they did not continue in his covenant, and he disregarded them.

answers.text: They kept it faithfully for many years
It was already written on their hearts
It was made after they left the wilderness
They did not continue in it, and he disregarded them

questions.text: Where will the Lord put his laws in the new covenant?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says he will put his laws into their mind and also write them on their heart.

answers.text: On tablets of stone
In the ark of the covenant
Into their mind and on their heart
In the hands of the priests

questions.text: What will no longer be needed, according to verse 11?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says they will not teach one another, saying "Know the Lord", for all will know him, from their least to their greatest.

answers.text: Teaching one another to know the Lord
Offering sacrifices for sin
Keeping the Sabbath day
Reading the book of the law

questions.text: What does the Lord promise to remember no more?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says he will be merciful to their unrighteousness and will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.

answers.text: Their fathers in Egypt
Their sins and lawless deeds
Their offerings and gifts
Their years in the wilderness
